description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the 'Module' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Setting' namespace. It provides methods to retrieve module settings from the database, specifically the 'getModule' method which fetches and decodes stored module configuration data.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents the 'Module' model class used for accessing module settings within the OpenCart catalog system.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves the settings for a specific module by its ID from the database, returning decoded JSON data as an array.
